resolution.title: Prepare the original AGOUTI environment
resolution.detail: The 2016 AGOUTI workflow is source-backed and Python 2-era. The current Bioconda package named agouti is a different program, so Somite will not install it by name.

recipes.title: Isolate the original AGOUTI source
recipes.summary: Prepare the paper-era implementation without substituting the unrelated modern package of the same name.
steps: Use the original AGOUTI repository linked by this recipe.
Create an isolated legacy environment that satisfies the upstream Python 2 requirements.
Run the upstream example before using study data.
Record the source revision and replace this reference with a reviewed Somite operator before execution.
